create.name: Dr. Nikki Mirghafori
create.bio:
Nikki Mirghafori is a Buddhist meditation teacher in the Theravada tradition and, in a parallel career, an artificial intelligence researcher with a doctorate in computer science from UC Berkeley. Born in Iran, she moved to the United States as a teenager, began meditating in 1991 and came to Theravada practice in 2003. With the Burmese master Venerable Pa Auk Sayadaw she trained in the jhānas, the deep absorptions of concentration, and in a detailed analytical style of insight meditation, and in 2008 he asked her to teach. She later completed the four-year joint teacher training of Spirit Rock and the Insight Meditation Society, and is a certified instructor of Stanford's compassion cultivation course.

Today she is a stewarding teacher and board member at Spirit Rock Meditation Center in Woodacre, California, and a regular teacher at Redwood City's Insight Meditation Center, where she leads Happy Hour, a free weekday evening class on loving-kindness and the other heart practices, streamed on Zoom and YouTube. Students describe a style that joins a scientist's precision with warmth and humour; recurring themes include mindfulness of death, concentration and kindness. A keen improviser, she also brings theatre games into her playful Mindful Improv weekends at Esalen. Her teaching is offered on a donation basis.

courses.title: Mindful Improv: Presence, Play and the Joy of Being Here
courses.description: A weekend at Esalen in Big Sur that pairs simple improvisational theatre games with guided meditation. Participants practise spontaneity, listening and kindness towards their own judgments, and try holding familiar roles and habits more lightly. No acting experience is needed.

courses.title: The Way of Release: Practicing Peace in Every Moment
courses.description: A seven-night silent residential retreat at Spirit Rock in Woodacre, California, held in the smaller upper meditation hall. The practice treats letting go as both the path and the goal, inviting ease and goodwill into each moment of awareness rather than effortful striving.

courses.title: The Joy of Samādhi: Practices to Cultivate Concentration
courses.description: A self-paced Spirit Rock course with about five hours of video teaching and six guided meditations on building concentration. It covers the conditions that support samādhi, how calm supports insight, and the five factors of jhāna, with lifetime access.

free_resources.title: Happy Hour
free_resources.description: A free drop-in class every Monday and Wednesday evening (Pacific time) through the Insight Meditation Center, on Zoom and YouTube. Each hour has a brief talk, a half-hour guided meditation on loving-kindness or another heart practice, small-group reflection and questions.

free_resources.title: Audio Talks and Guided Meditations
free_resources.description: Her page of free recorded Dharma talks and guided meditations, with links to her full archives on AudioDharma and Dharma Seed and a selection of favourite talks on gratitude, compassion and karma.

flags: Name kept as 'Dr. Nikki Mirghafori' because she presents herself as Dr. on her own site and Esalen; her PhD is in computer science, not a medical degree.
Follower counts could not be read for Facebook or X (her main accounts besides Instagram); readable total is tiny, tier local_hero.
Availability local_online with city Redwood City: she teaches at the Insight Meditation Center in Redwood City and at Spirit Rock in Woodacre, plus online; no personal studio address is published.
Booking URL is her Spirit Rock teacher page, which lists her upcoming programmes; her own site's calendar is a Google Calendar embed that could not be read.
A different YouTube channel, 'Tranquillity with Nikki' (hypnotic and quantum-healing meditations), is not her; none of its videos were used.
Second photo (on stage with a microphone) comes from her own bio page; looks like the same person as the 2026 Esalen portrait, slightly younger.
She has guided meditations on Insight Timer (linked from her audio page) but is not in the Insight Timer faculty list, so insight-timer is not added to teaches_at.
Spirit Rock retreat price is a sliding scale; scholarship rates below it exist.
